queries: WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), deviations AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_optvolrt, avg_optvolrt - AVG(avg_optvolrt) OVER () AS deviation FROM combinations), compared AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_optvolrt, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_deviation FROM deviations) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM compared WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_deviation GROUP BY tradekind

WITH combinations AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_optvolrt) AS value FROM combinations), deviations AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_optvolrt, c.avg_optvolrt - b.value AS deviation FROM combinations AS c CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL), type_averages AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT d.tradekind, AVG(d.avg_optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(d.deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(d.deviation - a.avg_deviation) AS avg_excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN type_averages AS a ON d.tradekind = a.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > a.avg_deviation GROUP BY d.tradekind
